subject.title: feat(dashboard): workspace document + control plane (plugin backend) [1/3]

question: Should OpenClaw accept this modular dashboard backend as a bundled enabled-by-default plugin after the storage, broadcast-scope, dependency, and labeler blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds a new core-bundled product surface and persistent operator data model; code review can identify blockers, but only maintainers can decide whether this belongs in OpenClaw core versus an optional plugin/ClawHub path.

options.title: Sponsor after blockers
options.body: Keep the stack open, require the storage/event/dependency/labeler fixes, and review the dashboard direction as a maintainer-sponsored bundled feature.

options.title: Move to optional plugin
options.body: Ask the contributor to keep this as a ClawHub or external plugin if OpenClaw core should not own an enabled-by-default dashboard workspace backend.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold or close the stack until maintainers explicitly decide the dashboard product direction and review budget.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep the stack open, require the storage/event/dependency/labeler fixes, and review the dashboard direction as a maintainer-sponsored bundled feature.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent owner of the plugin-tab seam and closest maintainer signal for bundled dashboard/plugin architecture decisions.
